@@ atx headings
# One
### Three ###
####### seven
@@ html
<h1>One</h1>
<h3>Three</h3>
<p>####### seven</p>
@@ setext
Title
=====
Sub
---
@@ html
<h1>Title</h1>
<h2>Sub</h2>
@@ paragraphs and breaks
one
two  
three\
four

five
@@ html
<p>one
two<br>
three<br>
four</p>
<p>five</p>
@@ emphasis
*a* _b_ **c** __d__ ***e*** snake_case_name 2 * 3 * 4
**bold *it* bold**
@@ html
<p><em>a</em> <em>b</em> <strong>c</strong> <strong>d</strong> <strong><em>e</em></strong> snake_case_name 2 * 3 * 4
<strong>bold <em>it</em> bold</strong></p>
@@ code span
use `a <b> *c*` and ``x ` y``
@@ html
<p>use <code>a &lt;b&gt; *c*</code> and <code>x ` y</code></p>
@@ escapes and entities
\*not em\* &copy; AT&T 1 < 2
@@ html
<p>*not em* &copy; AT&amp;T 1 &lt; 2</p>
@@ links
[home](/ "Home") and [ref][r] and [R] and <https://x.com/?a=1&b=2> and <me@x.com>

[r]: https://example.com/a_b_c "Ex"
@@ html
<p><a href="/" title="Home">home</a> and <a href="https://example.com/a_b_c" title="Ex">ref</a> and <a href="https://example.com/a_b_c" title="Ex">R</a> and <a href="https://x.com/?a=1&amp;b=2">https://x.com/?a=1&amp;b=2</a> and <a href="mailto:me@x.com">me@x.com</a></p>
@@ images
![IIS *badge*](/assets/images/IISSide.gif "Powered") [![b](/i.gif)](/x)
@@ html
<p><img src="/assets/images/IISSide.gif" alt="IIS badge" title="Powered"> <a href="/x"><img src="/i.gif" alt="b"></a></p>
@@ fenced code
```cfm
<cfset x = 1>

*no*
```
~~~
a
~~~
@@ html
<pre><code class="language-cfm">&lt;cfset x = 1&gt;

*no*
</code></pre>
<pre><code>a
</code></pre>
@@ indented code
para

    code <b>
      more

    end
@@ html
<p>para</p>
<pre><code>code &lt;b&gt;
  more

end
</code></pre>
@@ hr
---
* * *
@@ html
<hr>
<hr>
@@ blockquote
> # Q
> quoted
lazy
> - item
@@ html
<blockquote>
<h1>Q</h1>
<p>quoted
lazy</p>
<ul>
<li>item</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
@@ tight list nested
- one
- two
  - sub *a*
  - sub b
- three
@@ html
<ul>
<li>one</li>
<li>two
<ul>
<li>sub <em>a</em></li>
<li>sub b</li>
</ul></li>
<li>three</li>
</ul>
@@ loose ordered list
3. first

4. second
   more
@@ html
<ol start="3">
<li><p>first</p></li>
<li><p>second
more</p></li>
</ol>
@@ list types change
- a
+ b
1) c
@@ html
<ul>
<li>a</li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li>b</li>
</ul>
<ol>
<li>c</li>
</ol>
@@ html block and inline html
<div class="x">
*raw*
</div>

text <span class="y">*em*</span> <!-- c -->
@@ html
<div class="x">
*raw*
</div>
<p>text <span class="y"><em>em</em></span> <!-- c --></p>
@@ paragraph then list
para
- item
@@ html
<p>para</p>
<ul>
<li>item</li>
</ul>
@@ empty angle brackets and a lone <
a <> b < c
@@ html
<p>a &lt;&gt; b &lt; c</p>
@@ trailing backslash
end\
@@ html
<p>end\</p>
@@ empty link target
[x]() and [y]
@@ html
<p><a href="">x</a> and [y]</p>
@@ unclosed fence
```
code
@@ html
<pre><code>code
</code></pre>
@@ markers stay in their paragraph
a *b `c [d <e

f* g` h] i>
@@ html
<p>a *b `c [d &lt;e</p>
<p>f* g` h] i&gt;</p>
@@ markers stay in their list item
- *a
- b*
@@ html
<ul>
<li>*a</li>
<li>b*</li>
</ul>
@@ heading then paragraph emphasis
# T *x

y* z
@@ html
<h1>T *x</h1>
<p>y* z</p>
